# Aspen II Homes

> Aspen II Homes is a local new home builder in Tehachapi, California (CSLB license #1004058). The same owners have built in Tehachapi since 1994, first as Aspen Homes, Inc.; Aspen II Homes, Inc. has been licensed since 2015. It builds new single-story and two-story homes in Tehachapi and serves buyers across eastern Kern County: Golden Hills, Bear Valley Springs, Stallion Springs, Cummings Valley, California City, Mojave and Ridgecrest. It sells spec homes and semi-custom homes built from six floor plans; buyers choose finishes. It does not build fully custom homes or build on a buyer's own lot.

Prices and availability were last confirmed September 2026 and change; confirm with Aspen II Homes before relying on them.

- 1,715 sq ft, 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, single-story

## Financing and incentives

- 0% down options for eligible first-time buyers, plus FHA, VA and conventional loans (through lenders; Aspen II Homes is not a lender)
- Up to $15,000 early-buyer savings at Sunset Retreat (terms apply)
- 2-1 rate buydown and closing-cost credits may be available
- All programs subject to eligibility, lender approval and program terms
- Details: https://aspen2homes.com/financing/

## Buyer guides

- [First-time buyer programs in Kern County](https://aspen2homes.com/guides/first-time-buyer-programs-kern-county/): CalHFA MyHome, Dream For All, VA and FHA, with sources
